title: using an undeclared projection prefix is an error
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

rejection.justification: spec 11.3 states the prefix rules are semantic errors before execution; a parser may also reject an unknown prefix.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.3: use of an undeclared prefix is a semantic error before execution.
